summary: WF Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a standby equity purchase agreement with an institutional investor, committing up to $30 million for future share sales. The issuer will issue 750,000 commitment shares as consideration. Purchase price is 50% of the lower of either $1.01 or the lowest closing price over 180 days, with a floor of $0.10. Sales are discretionary over 24 months, with a 9.99% beneficial ownership cap. The structure resembles an equity line, dilutive overhang. Watch for future drawdowns and dilution impact on shareholders.
